# TradeData.io — Global Customs & Bill of Lading Intelligence API
> Operating Entity: TRADE DATA PTE. LTD. (Singapore HQ)
> Primary Anchor: TradeData Api | Import Export Data Source
> Official Hub: https://tradedata.io

## Overview
TradeData.io provides high-throughput, API-first access to 10 Billion+ verified customs declaration and Bill of Lading records across 200+ countries. Engineered specifically for automated ERP pipelines, logistics developers, and autonomous AI agents.

## Official Client SDKs & Registries
- Python (PyPI DR 92): https://pypi.org/project/tradedata-client/ (`pip install tradedata-client`)
- TypeScript / Node.js (npm DR 93): https://www.npmjs.com/package/@topsearch/tradedata-client (`npm i @topsearch/tradedata-client`)
- GitHub Repository (DR 96): https://github.com/top-search/tradedata-client
- Interactive OpenAPI & Postman: https://top-search.github.io/tradedata-client/

## Architectural Comparison Guides for Developers
- 2026 High-Intent Developer FAQ & Answer Capsules: https://top-search.github.io/tradedata-client/docs/developer-faq-answer-capsules-2026.md

## 11 Dedicated Regional Nodes
- Global API Gateway: https://tradedata.io
- Singapore ASEAN HQ: https://tradedata.sg
- Vietnam Customs Node: https://tradedata.vn
- United Kingdom Node: https://tradedata.uk
- United Arab Emirates Hub: https://tradedata.ae
- Spain & LatAm Node: https://tradedata.es
- Regional Hubs: https://tradedata.id (Indonesia), https://tradedata.in (India), https://tradedata.my (Malaysia), https://tradedata.tr (Turkey), https://tradedata.world (Global Diagnostics)

## Data Schema & 25+ Customs Parameters
Every record returns structured JSON including: bill_of_lading, container_number, customs_declaration_no, hs_code (6-10 digits), exporter_name, exporter_country, importer_name, importer_country, notify_party, carrier_scac, vessel_name, voyage_number, port_of_loading, port_of_discharge, gross_weight_kg, teu, quantity, unit, customs_value (USD), incoterms (CIF/FOB).
